svg.title: Burj priming tower beside a taller, narrowing vessel
svg.desc: Orthographic illustration from a synthetic two-tool example. A steel-blue faceted vessel reaches 184.8 mm. The green Burj tower shares its build plane. It holds its broad three-lobed base width until the vessel's widest section and tapers to a flat, three-lobed top. The amber line marks the final tool change from T0 to T1 at 144 mm. The XY view overlays the base at 48 mm wide and the top at 24 mm wide. Dimensions exclude brim. Colours identify geometry. No native slice or physical print is shown.
svg.metadata: Public synthetic geometry. Source: skills/printing/torre-burj/scripts/burj/geometry.py, make_plan and profile (36 vertices). Shared 0.2 mm layers. Synthetic vessel outer diameter [z,mm]: [[0,73],[2.4,77],[6,78],[18,95],[36,111],[49.2,116],[60,114],[78,102],[96,84],[115.2,62],[132,46],[144,36],[156,29],[164.4,28],[172.8,29],[178.8,33.2],[181.2,37],[183.6,37],[184.8,35.4]]. Two 16-sided walls, inner diameter 3.2 mm smaller. Tools: T0 initially, T1 at 36 mm, T0 at 78 mm, T1 at 144 mm. Options: references/options.example.json, primary_object_ids=[1], brim_mm=0.
